description: This file defines the SourceBuilder interface, a fluent API for constructing Source objects with various configuration options such as addresses, acknowledgment requests, header mappings, and more.

classes.name: SourceBuilder
classes.description: A fluent interface for building Source objects with configurable parameters such as addresses, acknowledgment requests, header mappings, and more.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Sets multiple addresses for the source.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Adds a single address to the source.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the index of the source inside a connection.

methods.name: qos
methods.description: Sets the Quality of Service level.

methods.name: enforcement
methods.description: Sets enforcement options, may be null.

methods.name: acknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Sets acknowledgement requests with optional filters.

methods.name: declaredAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels for incoming acknowledgements.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the configured Source instance.
